rows.draft: Hi Jordan, thanks for reaching out about a portfolio website redesign. We'd be happy to discuss scope and timeline; when is a good time for a call this week? Please don't send any banking or account details by email. We'll share our standard vendor onboarding through a secure channel if you move forward.

rows.tricky: business email compromise: lookalike of the real vendor domain printworks-sav.example, bank change, urgency, 'don't call us'
rows.reason: This looks like a business email compromise scam: it demands an urgent wire to a changed bank account, asks for secrecy, and discourages phone verification. Do not pay, and verify any real balance with PrintWorks through a contact you already have on file.
